description: Estimate what a British Airways ticket earns (miles or points, and status credit where it applies), using cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in GBP, not US dollars. Unofficial.

addons.description: Add-ons (GBP, optional). Paid seats, extra bags and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF): 2 tier points per £1, and Avios at your tier rate. Tier points from SAF are capped at 2,000 a year.

cl.description: Cabin. WT = World Traveller (economy); WP = World Traveller Plus (premium economy); CW = Club World (business); FI = First. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of British Airways's own: alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

cs.description: Cabin. ET = Euro Traveller (economy); CE = Club Europe (business). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

fce.description: Club Europe fare type. BU = Business (+175 tier points); SF = Semi-Flex (+275 tier points); FF = Fully-Flex (+375 tier points). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

fcw.description: Club World fare type. BU = Business (+500 tier points (200 from 1 April 2027)); SF = Semi-Flex (+700 tier points (400 from 1 April 2027)); FX = Flex (+900 tier points (600 from 1 April 2027)); FF = Fully-Flex (+1,100 tier points (800 from 1 April 2027)). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

fet.description: Euro Traveller fare type. B = Basic (no extra tier points); P = Plus (+75 tier points); SF = Semi-Flex (+175 tier points); FF = Fully-Flex (+275 tier points). Basic is the Basic Economy fare: it earns no extra tier points. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

ffi.description: First fare type. FI = First (+650 tier points (300 from 1 April 2027)); SF = Semi-Flex (+850 tier points (500 from 1 April 2027)); FX = Flex (+1,050 tier points (700 from 1 April 2027)); FF = Fully-Flex (+1,250 tier points (900 from 1 April 2027)). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

flights.description: Number of flights. Each flight earns the extra tier points: a return trip is 2 flights, and a connection adds one per leg.

fwp.description: World Traveller Plus fare type. PE = Premium Economy (+275 tier points (175 from 1 April 2027)); SF = Semi-Flex (+375 tier points); FX = Flex (+475 tier points); FF = Fully-Flex (+575 tier points). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

fwt.description: World Traveller fare type. B = Basic (no extra tier points); ST = Standard (+150 tier points); SF = Semi-Flex (+250 tier points); FX = Flex (+350 tier points); FF = Fully-Flex (+450 tier points). Basic is the Basic Economy fare: it earns no extra tier points. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

haul.description: Short haul or long haul. S = Short haul; L = Long haul. Short haul is Euro Traveller and Club Europe; long haul is World Traveller, World Traveller Plus, Club World and First.

price.description: Fare paid (GBP, whole ticket) in GBP. In pounds: base fare plus carrier-imposed charges for the whole ticket, without government taxes and airport charges. British Airways converts other currencies at the IATA 5-day rate on the day you buy. Required unless creditTo is given.

status.description: Your British Airways Club tier. BL = Blue; BR = Bronze; SV = Silver; GD = Gold.

tp.description: Tier points you have so far (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next tier.

yr.description: When you fly. 26 = Up to 31 March 2027; 27 = From 1 April 2027. From 1 April 2027 British Airways lowers the extra tier points on some long-haul fares (World Traveller Plus Premium Economy, Club World and First) and Silver needs 8,000 tier points, Gold 21,000.
